Briefing.Hazard: The Pacific runs the whole left side: anything over the cliff edge is in the penalty area.
Briefing.SafePlan: Aim at the right half of the green. Short and right leaves an easy chip from the fairway.

Briefing.Hazard: Bunkers pinch the fairway at the landing area and the pines on the left ridge block any hook.
Briefing.SafePlan: Lay up with the 3-wood short of the bunkers, then a short iron to the raised green.

Briefing.Hazard: Carmel Bay wraps behind and left of the green: long or left is in the penalty area.
Briefing.SafePlan: Take one more club into the breeze and aim at the right-centre of the green.

Briefing.Hazard: The Pacific runs the whole right side, and the second shot has to climb the headland over a cross bunker.
Briefing.SafePlan: Drive down the left half, lay up short of the cross bunker, then a wedge up the hill to the green.

Briefing.Hazard: A tiny green on the tip of the point: the ocean is long, left and right, and five bunkers ring it.
Briefing.SafePlan: Downhill, so club down and aim at the centre of the green. Short is the only safe miss.

Briefing.Hazard: A blind drive up the hill, then the approach carries the chasm: anything short or right is in the Pacific.
Briefing.SafePlan: 3-wood to the top of the plateau, then aim the approach at the left half of the green.
